summary: sysinfo is declared with default features (component, disk, gpu, network, system, user) while the crate uses only the system and disk APIs, so unused Windows and macOS feature code is compiled
evidence: crates/platform/Cargo.toml:9; sysinfo-0.40.4 Cargo.toml:73-80 defaults; windows/mod.rs:11,32,39,41,58-65 uses only System, MINIMUM_CPU_UPDATE_INTERVAL, Disks, Error
failure_scenario: No runtime fault. Longer compile time and larger binary surface; dropping unused features would also remove objc2-open-directory from the lock. Hygiene only.
resolution_note: Accepted per owner rule 2026-11-18: low and info findings are not fixed in this round; recorded in docs/status/audit.md.
